editorialSummary.heading: Planning around Flagler's hurricane make-up days
highlights: Thanksgiving (Nov 23–27) and holiday break (Dec 21–Jan 1) contain possible make-up days
January 4–5 are separate staff days; January 6 is the scheduled return
May 26–27 are early-release days, including the last student day
paragraphs: Flagler has a few single-day closures that can affect childcare plans. The published calendar lists August 18 for professional learning, November 3 for Election Day and November 11 for Veterans Day. October 12 was also designated a teacher workday and possible hurricane make-up day; the calendar alone cannot confirm whether it was used.

The published Thanksgiving break is November 23–27, but November 23–24 may be used for hurricane make-up. Holiday break runs December 21–January 1, with December 21–22 on the same reserve list. January 4–5 are separate staff days that could also become make-up days. The calendar gives January 6 as the regular return date, so check district notices before making travel plans.
Spring break is March 15–19, 2027. March 12 is a separate teacher workday and another possible make-up day. The last student day is May 27. Final report cards are scheduled for June 8.

Students have early release on May 26 and May 27, 2027. Both are school days, with May 27 also ending the student year. The district calendar gives no dismissal times; check your school's pickup and bus notices for the shortened schedule.

about.dataSource: The supplied PDF matches the current download linked on Flagler Schools’ Calendar page by SHA-256. Its visible heading is 2026-27 District Calendar. It supplies quarter lengths, an eight-date hurricane make-up list and a two-date early-release list. The month grids also identify progress reports and report cards through distinct symbols.
about.processing: Extracted the text and visually reviewed the full page and legend. Open circles mark progress reports on September 9, November 12, February 5 and April 22. Triangles mark report cards on October 16, January 7, March 24 and June 8; these shapes are not no-school or early-release markers. The May 27 square also establishes a quarter endpoint, alongside the printed semester-end/last-day wording and blue early-release mark, so one occurrence retains all four classifications. October 9, December 18 and March 11 remain ordinary quarter-end attendance dates. Eight purple half-circle dates retain their published no-school baseline and possible make-up flags, with the published order retained in conditionalNoSchoolDayEventIds. Thanksgiving and holiday breaks are divided into conditional single dates and fixed subranges so an entire break is not treated as conditional or guaranteed. The November 25-27 and December 23-January 1 fixed subranges have derived range boundaries within the larger official named breaks. The named Thanksgiving November 23-27 and holiday December 21-January 1 ranges remain official in the planning summaries. January 4 and 5 remain separate staff-day student closures; January 6 is the explicit baseline return. March 12 remains separate from March 15-19 spring break. There are 209 weekdays from August 10 to May 27, minus 22 fixed no-class weekdays and eight conditional reserve weekdays, yielding 179 planned attendance weekdays. This agrees with the sum of the printed quarter figures 43+42+45+49; neither sum nor grid count is a separately printed annual total. The longest-break statistic uses only fixed closures, while the planned winter stretch can be longer if reserves are unused. June 8 is final reporting, not attendance. August 3-7 pre-planning and post-year May 28 work/May 31 holiday dates are omitted. The PDF metadata title still says DRAFT 26-27 District Calendar, but the visible page has no draft label and the district currently links it as its district calendar. No approval date is inferred from that metadata or the December 2025 creation timestamp. Election Day uses the blue School not in session marker rather than the holiday marker; its NON_STUDENT_DAY classification is a derived normalization of that official no-school status.

The complete rendered page and legend confirm the Election Day no-school marker, eight ordered possible make-up dates, May 26-27 early release and June 8 report-card symbol. faqs.question: When does Flagler Schools start the 2026–2027 school year?
faqs.answer: The first day of school is Monday, August 10, 2026. The district calendar does not mark it as an early-release day.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school in Flagler County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Thursday, May 27, 2027 is the last day for students. It is also an early-release day and the end of the fourth quarter and second semester.

faqs.question: Does this calendar apply to Palm Coast schools?
faqs.answer: Yes. This is the 2026–27 Flagler Schools district calendar for its regular public schools in Flagler County, including Palm Coast and Bunnell. Individual schools may post additional events and dismissal information.

faqs.question: Why is there no school on August 18, 2026?
faqs.answer: Tuesday, August 18 is a Professional Learning Day with no classes for students. The next scheduled student day is Wednesday, August 19.

faqs.question: Does Flagler Schools have a fall break in October 2026?
faqs.answer: No separate fall-break week is listed on the district calendar. October 12 was designated a teacher workday and possible hurricane make-up day, not part of a named fall break.

faqs.question: Was Columbus Day (October 12, 2026) a school holiday for Flagler Schools?
faqs.answer: Flagler Schools did not label October 12 as a holiday. The published calendar listed it as a teacher workday with no scheduled student classes and as a possible hurricane make-up day. The PDF does not establish whether the reserve was activated.

faqs.question: Is there school on Election Day, November 3, 2026, in Flagler County?
faqs.answer: No. Flagler Schools lists Tuesday, November 3 as Election Day with no school for students. Classes are scheduled to resume Wednesday, November 4.

faqs.question: Is there school on Veterans Day, November 11, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Wednesday, November 11 is listed as a no-school holiday. The next scheduled school day is Thursday, November 12, which is also a progress-report date.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in Flagler County schools?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving break is November 23–27, 2026, with classes scheduled to resume Monday, November 30. November 23 and 24 are possible hurricane make-up days. November 25–27 are not on the published make-up list.

faqs.question: When is winter break for Flagler Schools in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: The official Holiday Break runs from December 21, 2026 through January 1, 2027. December 21 and 22 are possible hurricane make-up days. January 4 and 5 are separate staff days with no scheduled student classes, but both are also reserved for possible make-up.

faqs.question: When do Flagler Schools students return after winter break?
faqs.answer: Wednesday, January 6, 2027 is the published return date. January 4 and 5 are scheduled student days off but could be used for hurricane make-up, so check district announcements before finalizing travel.

faqs.question: What are the possible hurricane make-up days in 2026–2027?
faqs.answer: Flagler Schools lists eight possible dates: October 12, November 23–24 and December 21–22, 2026; January 4–5 and March 12, 2027. These are reserved dates, not automatically confirmed student attendance days.

faqs.question: How can I check if a hurricane make-up day will be used?
faqs.answer: The district PDF lists possible make-up dates, not confirmed attendance changes. Check Flagler Schools announcements and ParentSquare messages from your child's school before treating a reserved date as a day off.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day, September 7, 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Flagler Schools lists Monday, September 7 as Labor Day with no school. Classes were scheduled to resume Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Are Flagler Schools closed on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027 is a no-school holiday. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Is there school on Presidents' Day, February 15, 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Flagler Schools lists Monday, February 15 as a no-school holiday. Students are scheduled to return Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: When is spring break 2027 for Flagler Schools?
faqs.answer: Spring break is Monday, March 15 through Friday, March 19, 2027. Classes are scheduled to resume Monday, March 22. March 12 is a separate teacher workday and possible hurricane make-up day, not part of the named spring break.

faqs.question: Is March 12, 2027 a day off before spring break?
faqs.answer: Friday, March 12 is listed as a teacher workday with no student classes, but it is also the final possible hurricane make-up date. If it is not used, students have ten consecutive days off from March 12 through March 21, including weekends.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday, March 26, 2027 a school holiday?
faqs.answer: The published Flagler Schools calendar does not mark Friday, March 26 as a no-school or early-release day. It remains a regular scheduled school day unless a later district or school notice changes the schedule.

faqs.question: When are the early-release days in May 2027?
faqs.answer: The district lists Wednesday, May 26 and Thursday, May 27, 2027 as early-release days. May 27 is also the last student day. No other early-release dates are identified in the district PDF.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal on May 26 and 27, 2027?
faqs.answer: The district calendar identifies both early-release dates but does not provide dismissal times. Check your child's school for the pickup and bus schedule.

faqs.question: When do Flagler Schools' grading quarters end?
faqs.answer: The four quarter-end dates are October 9 and December 18, 2026, followed by March 11 and May 27, 2027. Only May 27 is marked for early release; the other quarter ends are regular student attendance days on the published calendar.

faqs.question: When are progress reports issued for Flagler Schools?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 9 and November 12, 2026, and February 5 and April 22, 2027. These dates do not indicate school closures.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued in the 2026–27 school year?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 16, 2026, and January 7, March 24 and June 8, 2027. June 8 is after the last student day and does not mean students return to school.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are in Flagler Schools' 2026–27 year?
faqs.answer: The district PDF lists 43, 42, 45 and 49 student days for the four quarters, totaling 179. That annual figure is calculated from the printed quarter totals; the PDF does not state it separately. The attendance schedule could change if hurricane make-up days are activated.

faqs.answer: The printable 2026–27 District Calendar is linked from https://www.flaglerschools.com/calendar. For attendance changes, check district announcements and ParentSquare messages from your child's school rather than relying only on a saved PDF.
